description: This file implements helper routines for USB device enumeration and parameter configuration, primarily used in Android development for Windows host interactions with USB devices. It includes functions to get device interfaces, device details, and check for legacy drivers.

methods.name: bool GetSDKComplientParam(AdbOpenAccessType access_type,AdbOpenSharingMode sharing_mode,ULONG * desired_access,ULONG * desired_sharing)
methods.description: Sets desired access and sharing mode parameters based on specified access and sharing mode types.

methods.name: bool EnumerateDeviceInterfaces(GUID class_id,ULONG flags,bool exclude_removed,bool active_only,AdbEnumInterfaceArray * interfaces)
methods.description: Enumerates device interfaces based on device info handle and class GUID, with filters for removal and activity status.

methods.name: EnumerateDeviceInterfaces (overload)
methods.description: Enumerates device interfaces based on class GUID, with specified flags, and filters.

methods.name: bool GetUsbDeviceDetails(HDEVINFO hardware_dev_info,PSP_DEVICE_INTERFACE_DATA dev_info_data,PSP_DEVICE_INTERFACE_DETAIL_DATA * dev_info_detail_data)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed device interface data, allocating necessary buffer memory.

methods.name: bool GetUsbDeviceName(HDEVINFO hardware_dev_info,PSP_DEVICE_INTERFACE_DATA dev_info_data,std::wstring * name)
methods.description: Obtains the device path (name) for a given device interface.

methods.name: bool IsLegacyInterface(const wchar_t * interface_name)
methods.description: Checks if a USB interface uses a legacy driver by attempting a specific IOCTL command.
